number: 第二百四十八条の四の五
heading_en: Revocation of Approval of the SA-CVA
summary_ja: 長官は、承認基準を満たさない場合にSA―CVAでの算出が不適当と判断したときは、承認を取り消すことができる。
summary_en: The Commissioner may revoke the SA-CVA approval where a standards failure makes calculation under the SA-CVA inappropriate.
paragraphs: Where, in a case listed in paragraph (1), item (iii) of the preceding Article, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency determines that it is inappropriate to calculate the CVA risk equivalent amount using the SA-CVA, the Commissioner may revoke the approval under Article 248-4, paragraph (1).
